title: One sky line between X and Y on a royal natal line of each end
text: A scoring royal natal line to X (c R – c X; conj / contraparallel not counted; any chart and plane) is carried by the sky line S X – S Y itself (a 'Sky lines on the same target' row naming X; Y not a royal star or the Moon; the line not conj / contraparallel), and in Y's sheet the same sky line (same plane) carries a royal natal line to Y (c' R' – c' Y, not conj / contraparallel). Held on both bodies X and Y. Any score.
